<div id="app"><header><span class="emblem">SC</span><div><strong>SCALP CITY</strong><small>v1.7.2 · GLB engine test</small></div><div id="status">Initialising…</div></header>
<main><canvas id="view"></canvas><button id="openPane">Menu</button>
<section class="pane" id="pane"><h2>Institution Explorer</h2><p>This viewer loads the actual repaired GLB meshes, their materials, bones and animation clips. No CDN required.</p>
<div class="field"><b>Camera / control</b><div class="btns"><button id="overview" class="active">Campus view</button><button id="follow">Third-person</button></div></div>
<div class="field"><b>Character</b><div class="btns"><button id="workerBtn" class="active">Worker</button><button id="operatorBtn">Operator A</button></div></div>
<div class="field"><b>Destination</b><select id="floor"><option value="outside">Campus outside</option><optgroup label="School"><option value="s0">School · Foundation</option><option value="s1">School · Training</option><option value="s2">School · Assessment</option></optgroup><optgroup label="Trading Tower"><option value="t0">Tower · Exchange</option><option value="t1">Tower · Paper Trading</option><option value="t2">Tower · Journeyman</option><option value="t3">Tower · Qualification</option><option value="t4">Tower · Guardian</option><option value="t5">Tower · Risk</option><option value="t6">Tower · Research</option><option value="t7">Tower · Capital</option><option value="t8">Tower · Live Ops</option><option value="t9">Tower · Portfolio</option><option value="t10">Tower · CEO</option></optgroup></select></div>
<div class="field"><b>Animation</b><div class="btns"><button id="idleBtn" class="active">Idle</button><button id="walkBtn">Walk</button></div></div>
<div class="field"><b>Display</b><div class="btns"><button id="cutBtn">Cutaway off</button><button id="resetBtn">Reset camera</button></div></div>
<div class="footer">Desktop: WASD / arrow keys to move, Shift to run, drag to orbit, wheel to zoom.<br/>Mobile: drag the canvas to orbit; virtual joystick to move. Interiors are a **visual cutaway prototype**, not collision-tested.
<div class="badge">LOCAL ONLY · No brokerage connection</div></div></section>
<div id="hud"><strong id="place">Campus Overview</strong><span id="coords">Y-up geometry · GLB native</span><div id="animState">Waiting for models</div></div>
<div id="warning"></div><div id="joy"><div id="nub"></div></div><button id="run">RUN</button><div id="loader">Loading native GLB models…</div></main></div>
